data.one_liner: A flutter plugin to get device RAM size.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that allows applications to retrieve the physical RAM size of the device. It provides an asynchronous method to fetch the system memory in megabytes. Supports Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need to retrieve the device physical memory size in your Flutter app.
You are building apps for Android and iOS that require hardware memory information.
avoid_when: You need detailed device information beyond just physical memory (like CPU, OS version, or battery), as this plugin specifically focuses on RAM.
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Simple and straightforward API for retrieving device RAM.
weaknesses: Very limited scope (only provides physical memory).
Only documented for Android and iOS.
